ZB-1013.reason: The wiki specifies the warehouse 4 lever and a ZB-1013 key. The snapshot repeats this lever on all Customs extracts; bind it only here.
ZB-1013.note: Activate the warehouse 4 lever and bring the ZB-1013 key.

Old Gas Station.reason: The wiki's green flare is an availability indicator, not a flare the player must fire. PMC and Scav availability differs.

pmc.note: Available to PMCs when the green signal is lit.

scav.note: No equipment or payment required for Scavs.

D-2.reason: The wiki requires bunker power and the door button. The snapshot omits extract references; the named D2_LEVER switch identifies the power lever.
D-2.note: Turn on bunker power, then press the button beside the D-2 door.

Bunker Hermetic Door.reason: The wiki identifies the exterior extraction lever; the snapshot's EXFIL lever is distinct from D2_LEVER and the D-2 gate button.
Bunker Hermetic Door.note: Activate the exterior lever; the exit stays active for four minutes.

Armored Train.reason: An empty equipment-requirements cell does not describe the train schedule. The wiki says the train arrives late and departs once.
Armored Train.note: Board after the train arrives; it leaves once per raid.

Armored Train.reason: The wiki lists the train as always available, but extraction still requires its scheduled departure.
Armored Train.note: Board after the train arrives; extraction happens on departure.

RUAF Gate.reason: The wiki's green flare marks an open exit; it is not a player-fired flare requirement.
RUAF Gate.note: Available when the green signal is lit.

ZB-016.reason: The wiki's green flares are availability indicators rather than items to bring.
ZB-016.note: Available when the green signals are lit.

ZB-014.reason: The wiki requires both an active green signal and the ZB-014 key; retain the key and explain the availability condition.
ZB-014.note: Bring the ZB-014 key; the green signals must be lit.

Pier Boat.reason: The wiki's green flare is an open-exit indicator, not a player-fired flare requirement.
Pier Boat.note: Available when the green signal is lit.

Courtyard.reason: The wiki's green flare indicates availability; firing a flare is not required.
Courtyard.note: Available when the green signal is lit.

Hangar Gate.reason: The wiki requires opening the gate from the B24 control cabin. The repeated snapshot switch list does not identify that control reliably.
Hangar Gate.note: Open the hangar gate from the control in cabin B24.

Parking Gate.reason: The wiki requires opening the gate from Y21. The repeated snapshot switch list does not identify that control reliably.
Parking Gate.note: Open the parking gate from the control in room Y21.

Sewage Conduit.reason: The wiki requires draining water at the B1 switch; the snapshot names a Pump_button distinct from the unrelated repeated extraction switch list.
Sewage Conduit.note: Press the pump switch in B1 and wait for the water to drain.

The Way Up.reason: The wiki specifies a fifteen-minute delay, which is not an item or switch requirement.
The Way Up.note: Available fifteen minutes after raid start.

Helicopter.reason: The wiki requires both a green flare and 2,400 euros per player. Keep the euro payment in the note; do not invent a rouble price.
Helicopter.note: Fire a green flare in the signal area and pay 2,400 euros per player.
